official_review.scope: Incremental audit of called configuration/API and failure interfaces; reuse pinned official references and source snapshots in owning proofs. No claim of reading all upstream manuals or validating every topology.

reuse_boundaries: Historical raw is unchanged. SHA-matching snapshots preserve original launcher bytes; compare owning branch and effective global header, ignore only build-only allowlist extensions.
StarMigrt README insertion is MySQL8.0-only; exact original README preserved. Physical8.4 setup/cleanup and physical function unchanged by portability fallback.
NetCheck retains original delivery-owner production acceptance/exemption; static audit is not new live evidence.
Kafka/Star new SSH proof covers bootstrap only; their unchanged local broker/database business evidence is not relabelled as a new run.
limits: No production access or deployment; no zero-defect guarantee.
Physical profile: AMD64 native Rocky8.10/9.8, MySQL8.0.33/8.0.46 in one Docker container, host/independent tool-container execution, GTID OFF/ON, no encryption.
No target-MySQL-container self-stop/full-restore claim; no replication/keyring/external general tablespace/Windows/ARM native qualification.
OVPN PKI proof does not certify VPN handshake/OpenSSL3; API proof does not certify Calico dataplane; portability help is startup only.
